answer: Metered GPU time vouchers. A provider signs a unique voucher for each paid GPU-hour, such as time spent rendering an ember lighting a prism on basalt. To grant an account reward, the ledger verifies the signature and marks the serial spent across all accounts. An attacker seeking N rewards must buy N GPU-hours, since replaying one voucher adds no credit. The rule depends on providers issuing vouchers only for metered, paid time.
